## First release

- A floating bubble docked at the screen edge: pulled out and pointed at a word in any app, it shows the dictionary entry next to the word.
- Cloud text recognition with an on-device draft, or the app's own text where available.
- Yomitan dictionaries with Yomitan's lookup, sorting and rendering: deinflection, furigana, frequencies, pitch accent, images and kanji entries.
- Bundled Jitendex, frequency list and pitch accents; more dictionaries from the download catalog, `.zip` files or a Yomitan collection export.
- Anki notes through AnkiDroid: deck, note type and field templates, duplicate checks, audio and cropped screenshots.
- Search screen and "Look up in Screenlate" in the text selection menu.
- Settings import from a Yomitan settings export.
- Popup font, text size and custom CSS; light and dark themes; English and Russian interface.
- In-app updates from GitHub Releases.

Download `arm64-v8a` for most phones, `armeabi-v7a` for older 32-bit devices, or the universal APK. Android 11 or newer.
